subject: Launch pulse: synoptic OKR alignment + contingency play
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch pulse: synoptic OKR alignment + contingency play

Team —

As we head into QBR prep next week I want a short, joined-up view of where we stand across the launch lanes (GTM, enablement, pricing, docs, and support). This will be the snapshot I share with execs on Thursday. Please read and action the three asks below by EOD Tuesday: 

1) One-line health (Green/Yellow/Red) + one sentence risk and mitigation for your lane.
2) Any changes to committed OKR metrics or acceptance criteria that will affect the QBR narrative.
3) Confirm final owners for the canary cohorts and who will be on-call during week 0.

I've attached the working playbook and latest pricing grid for reference. Key context: the launch window is still May 24-26; execs want one contingency that keeps latency SLOs intact if we need to fallback to the smaller model family.

Thanks — short bullets are great.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Director, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch pulse: synoptic OKR alignment + contingency play

Irene — quick updates from GTM/enablement side: 

Health: Yellow — training completion lagging (70% vs target 90%) but core playbook is stable.
Risk & mitigation: Instructor-led sessions bumped to this Wednesday/Thursday; recorded sessions will be published to the playbook folder; CS will run an office hour next Friday to catch late adopters.
OKR delta: No change to the primary activation metric (DAU conversion). We will shift one enablement OKR subtarget from "50 internal champions" to "35 champions + two office hours" to be realistic for the QBR narrative.
Owners & on-call: Marissa will own enablement rollouts; Laura + two enablement leads on call W0 for ramp.

Attachments referenced: I updated section 2.1 of launch_playbook_v1.pdf with session times. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-launch-playbook

Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of GTM Enablement
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch pulse: synoptic OKR alignment + contingency play

Quick pricing & channel note: 

Health: Green — pricing tiers finalized but one open ask with procurement for an enterprise consumption discount we can approve conditionally.
Risk & mitigation: If procurement pushback extends beyond Friday, we have pre-approved a short-term credit (up to 10%) for first 30 days; finance has pre-signed the approval sheet (see HS-10234). This keeps deals moving for QBR numbers.
OKR delta: No change to revenue recognition assumptions; will flag any closed-won that uses the credit for QBR transparency.
Owners & on-call: Karthik to own commercial exceptions; Vivek will be rotation backup for contract escalations.

I've attached pricing_grid_v3.xlsx with the final anchor and conditional credits noted.

— Karthik
Senior Director, Commercial Strategy
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch pulse: synoptic OKR alignment + contingency play

Docs & support check: 

Health: Yellow — docs delivery on target for core flows, but advanced telemetry docs (SLO explainers, debugging KB) are 2 days late.
Risk & mitigation: Publishing schedule accelerated; Monica will cover the initial support KB surface so CS can triage. Finalized runbook snippets attached (support_runbook_snippets.md).
OKR delta: No OKR changes. We'll annotate the QBR script to call out expected support load and first-48h escalation path.
Owners & on-call: Marissa will publish artifacts; Monica will be primary on-call W0; Vivek as escalation.

Forwarded for FYI to an external procurement thread with QuantumCloud (internal copy) — see the bottom of the thread for exchange with procurement@quantumcloud.io.

Marissa
Staff Product Manager, Documentation & UX
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch pulse: synoptic OKR alignment + contingency play

Thanks all — short confirmation from Support: 

Health: Green -> Yellow (due to docs lag) but mitigations in place.
Risk & mitigation: We will run two shadow shifts (Thu/Fri next week) with senior on-call present to validate alerting thresholds pre-launch. If the canary sees higher than expected error ratios, we will rollback to the smaller model family and enable stricter request sampling — this is the latency-preserving contingency Irene referenced.
OKR delta: No change. We'll add a postmortem OKR subtask to ensure lessons captured within 72 hours of any incident.
Owners & on-call: Monica primary W0, Vivek escalation, Laura enablement support during first 48h.

Next steps (for Irene to consolidate into the exec snapshot):
- Collect any last-minute escalations by Tue 5/18 EOD.
- Finalize the contingency wording (Irene + Karthik).
- Confirm canary cohort list (Marissa + Laura).

I'll join the QBR prep call Wednesday to walk the support readiness slide.

— Monica
Director, Customer Support
